Mean Follow-up Time (Years) and Standard: ARIC external validation follow-up N/A; article states ARIC had longer follow-up but exact median/IQR or mean/SD N/A
Data Sources: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP), a UK Biobank subcohort with plasma proteomics measured using Olink Explore; Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study (ARIC) with plasma proteomics measured using SomaScan version 4. Outcomes from linked health records: UKB-PPP primary care, hospital inpatient records, death register; ARIC hospitalization records, death certificates, and study visit ECGs.
Sample Characteristics: Main incident AF prediction population included individuals with plasma proteomic data and no history of AF at baseline. UKB-PPP included 1,459 unique plasma proteins after excluding NPM1, PCOLCE, CTSS, and TACSTD2 because >10% measurements were missing. ARIC visit 3 participants with available proteomic data and no AF history were included. Exploratory analysis included individuals with prior AF for death or stroke outcome; baseline model included CHA2DS2-VASc score, NT-proBNP, and oral anticoagulant use. UKB-PPP total for incident AF 51,680; derivation 36,176 and test 15,504. ARIC external validation 11,012. AF-history populations: UKB-PPP 1,025 and ARIC 171.
Median Age (Development) and IQR: UKB-PPP derivation median age 59 years (IQR 51-64); UKB-PPP test median 59 (IQR 50-64); ARIC median 60 (IQR 55-65)
Racial/Ethnic Composition (Development): UKB-PPP derivation: Black 884 (2.4%), Asian 795 (2.2%), White 33,669 (93.1%), mixed/unknown 828 (2.3%); UKB-PPP test: Black 312 (2.0%), Asian 321 (2.1%), White 14,491 (93.5%), mixed/unknown 380 (2.5%)
Racial/Ethnic Composition (Validation): ARIC: Black 2,318 (21.1%), White 9,524 (77.0%); Asian and mixed/unknown N/A
